draft.subject: Getting Union Logistics' first project set up
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

I know a new tool is easy to put off in a busy week, so I'll keep this short.

The usual first step is creating a project — in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that's in the way.

Best,
Nadia
